# Our recipes

## Lentil soup

- 200 g red lentils
- 1 onion, chopped
- 1 litre vegetable stock

Simmer for 25 minutes. Grandma adds a squeeze of lemon at the end.

## Banana bread

- 3 ripe bananas
- 250 g flour
- 100 g butter
- 2 eggs

Bake for 55 minutes at 175°C. Check with a skewer before taking it out.

## Pancakes

- 200 g flour
- 2 eggs
- 300 ml milk

Fry on a medium heat. The first one is always a test pancake.

## Tomato salad

- 4 tomatoes
- half a red onion
- olive oil and salt

Salt the tomatoes ten minutes before serving so they give up their juice.

## Chilli

- 500 g minced beef or 2 tins of beans
- 1 tin of tomatoes
- 2 teaspoons chilli powder

Cook slowly for an hour. It tastes better the next day.
